in_marathi.name: Bharani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharani is a name of the Hindu goddess Durga, who is an embodiment of power and strength. She is often depicted with eight arms, holding various weapons, and riding a lion or tiger. Bharani is worshipped during the Navratri festival and is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and protection.
